# Private walkthrough image rights and identity record — 2026-10-28

These two unchanged files are third-party copyrighted content, **not covered by
any repository licence**. They are retained only for Jay's solely private,
non-commercial local buying walkthrough. Do not push, publish, deploy, package
for other users or redistribute them. `manifest.json` records original URLs,

Both files were opened and visually inspected. No AI image, unrelated watch,

## Source findings

- **Casio MTP-B145D-2A2VEF:** [Europe product context](https://www.casio.com/europe/watches/casio/product.MTP-B145D-2A2V/)
  links the individual blue/steel front and wrist photographs retained here.
  [UK product context](https://www.casio.com/uk/watches/casio/product.MTP-B145D-2A2V/)
  identifies the full VEF suffix and links the same front depiction. Europe
  [terms section 1](https://www.casio.com/europe/terms/) require written permission
  for copying/downloads beyond solely private use. Our justification is that
  express private-use exception, limited to this user's loopback walkthrough.
  Copyright/trademark notices remain beside both images. This is not an open
  licence or an assertion that regional packaging or any selected offer matches.
  The initial UK candidate was not used as the permission basis: its
  [terms](https://www.casio.com/uk/legal/terms-of-use/) also contain restrictive
  other-website wording. The Europe files were separately retrieved.
- **Militado ML05/ML05B:** [manufacturer ML05 page](https://www.militadowatch.com/en-gb/products/militado-38mm-sapphire-crystal-field-military-watch?variant=42433493139503)
  has a real gallery, but selections span logos, dials, case finishes, movements
  and calendars. This does not resolve ML05B or the buyer's exact selection.
  [Terms section 1](https://www.militadowatch.com/policies/terms-of-service)
  restrict reuse/display on another website or networked environment; section 11
  restricts automated access. No gallery or image download followed that finding.
  [Watchdives alternative](https://watchdives.com/products/militado-38mm-sapphire-crystal-field-watch)
  supplies product context but its [terms](https://watchdives.com/policies/terms-of-service)
  have the same reuse restriction. A personal-download clause was not treated as
  permission to rehost in PriceRecon. **Missing: reuse permission and exact depiction selection.**
- **Addiesdive AD2066 mint:** [manufacturer selected Mint Green context](https://www.addiesdivewatches.com/products/addiesdive-36mm-luxury-vh31-quartz-watch-ad2066?variant=44195491578021)
  identifies the named model/colour. [Terms sections 2 and 12](https://www.addiesdivewatches.com/policies/terms-of-service)
  require express permission for copying and prohibit scraping. No product
  gallery was downloaded. A [mint review video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n2mYtRhoDkA)
  and secondhand listings appeared, but neither supplies a checked transferable
  photo licence; video thumbnails/screenshots and seller photos were excluded.
  **Missing: permission to reproduce a mint product photo.**
- **San Martin SN0144:** [manufacturer family detail](https://www.sanmartin-watch.com/products/sn0144gx)
  has genuine product context, but explicitly spans sizes and coloured dials.
  [GX5 detail](https://www.sanmartin-watch.com/products/sn0144gx5) is a different
  specific revision. Neither establishes the fixture's unresolved selection.
  The manufacturer page reserves rights; its terms URL was inaccessible to the
  web reader. The [independent authorized retailer's terms section 14](https://www.sanmartin.watch/pages/terms-of-service)
  explicitly require relevant rights-holder permission for protected materials.
  That retailer identifies itself as independent, so it is not described as the
  manufacturer. **Missing: reuse permission and buyer-selected size/dial/revision.**
- **Merkur Lightning salmon:** exact-name searches did not reconcile this label
  to a manufacturer's reference. The [manufacturer catalogue](https://www.merkurwatch.com/)
  and [Ivory Salmon detail](https://www.merkurwatch.com/NEW-MERKUR-Handwinding-Mechanical-silver-dial-silver-index-%C2%A0Retro-Dress-Watch-Ivory-Salmon-dial-p1855118.html),
  [LEVEE detail](https://www.merkurwatch.com/The-New-MERKUR-red-12-Business-LEVEE-Series-Manual-Watch-Cross-Line-Dial-Salmon-Silver-Dial-Retro-Casual-Watch-for-Men-p2505236.html)
  and [salmon skin-diver alternative](https://watchmerkur.com/products/merkur-salmon-watches?variant=47251128811752)
  show why “a salmon Merkur” is insufficient. None establishes Lightning, and no
  checked photo-reuse grant was found. The manufacturer's privacy policy supplies
  no image licence. **Missing: original reference/product link and photo permission.**

Bounded alternative searches included exact model names with Creative Commons,
CC BY, licence/license and Wikimedia Commons queries. No exact licensed asset
was found; unrelated clocks and other watches were rejected. Public galleries,
search thumbnails and Reddit/marketplace images were not treated as licences.
This is a finite unsuccessful search, not proof that licensed photos cannot exist.
No accounts, contact, purchases, recurring collector or price ingestion occurred.

The official links above can be viewed in their original context as a separate
